claim: On 25 July 2019, the ERA5 grid-cell estimate for Paris, France, reached a daily maximum of 41.4 °C—the hottest day in the 1950–2025 record (rank 1 of 27,759 days) and the highest annual maximum among the 76 years assessed. It was 6.6 °C above the 1991–2020 mean annual maximum (TXx).
reason: Source confirms 41.4 °C on 2019-07-25, rank 1 of 27,759 days, would rank 1 of 76 annual TXx values, and +6.6 °C against baseline mean TXx. Claim is consistent with all these figures.
